question: ______ plains are formed due to the weathering of soluble rocks such as limestone and dolomite.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karst**__.

__
 
• **Karst plains are formed due to the weathering of soluble rocks such as limestone and dolomite**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Karst **is a distinctive topography in which the landscape is largely shaped by the dissolving action of water on **carbonate bedrock** such as **limestone and dolomite**, etc.

 
 
• When the rain falls through the atmosphere, it picks carbon dioxide which dissolves in the droplets.
 
• Once the rain hits the ground, it percolates through the soil and picks more carbon dioxide to form a weak solution of carbonic acid.
 
• The infiltrating water naturally exploits cracks in the rock.
 
• Over long periods, carbon bedrock begins to dissolve.
 
• Opening in bedrock increases in size and an underground drainage system begins to develop and allows more water to pass which further accelerates the formation process of karst.
 
• **Some of the landforms develop within the bedrock such as pools, sinkholes, doline, stalactites, stalagmites etc.**
 
• **​​Examples of karst topography:**
 
 
• Skocjan Caves, Slovenia
 
• The Puerto Princesa Underground River, Philippines
 
• Doline in the causse de Sauveterre, Lozere, France
 
• Li River, Guilin, China
